description: Adds a price the user pays or was quoted, anonymously, to the benchmark of what buyers actually pay (a median is published once five reports exist for an item). The only tool here that stores anything. Call it ONLY after the user has explicitly agreed to share this price; never on your own initiative. Nothing identifying is stored: no account, no address. Do not put names of people or the user's company in supplier.

price.description: token: input price in USD per 1M tokens; gpu: price per GPU-hour

supplier.description: The provider or channel the price is from, if the user said

user_agreed.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed to share this price

name: share_price
title: Share a price with the benchmark
